race.comment: MIND FIELD (7) is a handy galloper who was beaten just over a length by the smart Truly Loyal last time, which was the first run back from a spell. That looks a great platform for this and we'll get a line on the form a race earlier when Truly Loyal runs. If that's the right form then HARD SOLO (2) has to be a chance as she beat home MIND FIELD. She's a few more runs into the prep, though, so might not have as much improvement. DIAMOND DANCER (4) did well to fill a minor placing when resuming at this track but raced below expectations last time over 1200m at this track, finishing eighth and beaten 6 lengths. Finds a suitable assignment to return to her best. PISTONE (12) ran up to some super trials with a dominant first-up win, which was the performance of a horse who will measure up to this grade. SO SI GOD (9) wasn't beaten far last start, which was the second run back, so nearing peak fitness, just needs to overcome a terrible alley.
